title: Velvety Norwegian Chestnut Mushroom Risotto
description: A creamy and festive Norwegian dish featuring chestnut mushrooms and a hint of dashi extract, made dairy-free friendly. This risotto is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced chestnut mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the rice is coated in oil and slightly toasted.
Add the warm vegetable broth, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to absorb before adding the next.
After 20 minutes of cooking, stir in the dashi extract and non-dairy butter until the butter is melted and the risotto is creamy.
Season the risotto with salt and black pepper to taste.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the risotto immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
